a.lede: Cybersecurity company Barracuda Networks warned that attackers have begun exploiting two recently patched Email Security Gateway (ESG) vulnerabilities that let them run commands with root privileges. [...]
a.title: Hackers now exploit critical Barracuda ESG flaws to gain root access

b.lede: Check Point Software has released emergency hotfixes to address a high-severity flaw that hackers have been exploiting to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October. [...]
b.title: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
